goals: I can name habitats and climates.
I can join two ideas with so and because.
I can say where an animal can live.
I can talk about mammals.
I can ask "Could it live in a different habitat?"
I can say why an animal couldn't live somewhere.
I can read about an amazing animal.
I can say how an animal has adapted.
I can give an animal report.
sentences: Where can this animal live?
What are your favorite animals? Where can they live?
Which word tells us WHY? Where does the comma go?
I am hungry, **so** I am eating pizza.
It is very cold, **so** few plants grow there.
I am hungry **because** I did not eat breakfast.
Polar bears have thick fur **because** it is cold.
Snakes can live in the polar regions.
What animal is it? Where can it live?
What animal has sharp quills?
Could this animal live in the ocean?
What habitat is it? What animals couldn't live here? Why not?
Which word do we use for a "what if" question?
Dolphins **can** live in the ocean.
Camels **can** live in the desert.
**Could** it live in a different habitat?
No, it **couldn't** live in the desert because it needs water.
Which mammal was missing?
What do you know about them? Could they live in a different habitat?
Leopards carry their food up into trees.
What mammal is it?
Which animal can change its color?
Why does this animal shoot ink?
What animal is it? Where can it live? What can it eat?
Can you make one sentence with so and one with because?
The fish is scared, **so** it swims away.
It is raining, **so** I have an umbrella.
He eats pizza **because** he is hungry.
It looks like a squid **because** they are related.
Cuttlefish have very small brains.
What animals are these?
What can we get from here?

goals: I can name natural resources.
I can say "If I were …, I would …"
I can say what would happen without a resource.
I can talk about how we use water.
I can ask "If …, what would happen?"
I can think of ways to save water.
I can say where things come from.
I can use the present perfect.
I can ask "What can you get from here?"
sentences: What can you get from nature?
Is it real or just imagined? Why do we say "I were", not "I was"?
**If I were** there,
**If I were** a bird,
**If there were** no water,
I **would help** them.
I **would fly** to the mountains.
we **would die**.
Lightning is electricity in nature.
What is this? What do we get from it?
How many glasses of water do you drink a day?
Why is water so important?
How many glasses of water can you drink in a day?
What word is in both the question and the answer?
If there were no water, what **would** happen?
If we didn't have a dishwasher, what **would** happen?
If there were no water, we **would** be thirsty.
If we didn't have a dishwasher, we **would** wash the dishes by hand.
About 60% of our body is water.
If she used a cup to brush her teeth, how much water would she save?
What are they doing?
Where did this chair come from?
Where did my chair come from?
Which one tells us it is still true now?
I **got** it five years ago.
It **came** from a forest.
I **have had** it for five years.
I **have used** it every day.
Leather comes from trees.
What can you get from them?
What can you get from here?
What is wrong with this picture?

goals: I can name environmental problems.
I can say a cause and an effect.
I can say "I think …"
I can say how people help the earth.
I can ask politely: "Would you please …?"
I can say what I can do for the earth.
I can say "If I saw this, I would …"
I can talk about my own habits.
I can change my behavior to help the earth.
sentences: Why is our planet in trouble?
What do you think about this?
Can you join them with so? "Factories make smoke, so …"
Factories and cars make smoke.
People catch too many fish.
The air gets dirty.
Some fish species disappear.
Overfishing means people catch too few fish.
What animal is it? Why is it in trouble?
How can we help the earth?
What can you do for the earth?
What can you do about this?
Which one would you say to a grown-up you don't know?
**Pick up** your trash.
**Stop** cutting the tree.
**Would you please** pick up your trash?
**Could you please** stop cutting the tree?
What are they doing? How are they helping the environment?
What does a park ranger do? Would you like this job?
